text:
erin: FYI: we're doing a keyed-cohort rollout for feature flag `smart_batch_v4`. Window: 02:00-04:00 UTC. Ramp plan: 0.2% -> 1% -> 5% -> 15% with 10m holdpoints. Pin model routing param `batcher_version=4.1.0` for cohorts.
frank: Who's driving monitoring? I'll watch infra and autoscaler.
erin: @frank thanks. @gabby you're on quality for the first 2 holds.
gabby: Got it. I'll run the A/B prompt deck and watch token-level divergence.
helen: Add a fast-fail rule: if errors >= 0.4% OR p95 latency increases > 40% relative to baseline over the hold window, auto-dry-run rollback to `batcher_version=4.0.7` and disable `smart_batch_v4`.
erin: Agreed. Also enable `kv_prefill=true` for pinned cohort to smooth warmup.
deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout 3645009999. Commands to be executed:
```
ffctl enable smart_batch_v4 --cohort=keyed_hash:0.2% --param batcher_version=4.1.0 --meta kv_prefill=true
monitorctl subscribe --metrics latency_p95,errors,token_divergence --window=10m
```
I'll post progress every 2m.
deploy-bot: (initial) 0.2% keyed cohort enabled. Warmup running.
(4m) deploy-bot: metrics: p50 90ms p95 210ms errors 0.01% token-divergence 0.0% — progressing to 1% in 1m.
frank: Infra looks green. No queue pressure on the batcher.
gabby: Smoke eval started. First pass looks neutral.
deploy-bot: 1% enabled. Holding for 10m.
(8m) deploy-bot: holdpoint metrics: p95 +5% vs baseline, errors 0.02%, token-divergence +0.9% — below alert. Ready to proceed to 5%.
erin: Proceed. Keep the keyed cohort pin active. Note: cohort hashing excludes internal users.
(22m) deploy-bot: 5% enabled. Holding.
gabby: Eval delta showing -0.8% on accuracy metric for the A deck, but signal noisy. I'm re-running with fixed seeds.
frank: Noticing slight spike in CPU on node pool batcher-3, small autoscale reaction. Tracking.
deploy-bot: (holdpoint) p95 +18% vs baseline, errors 0.15%, token-divergence +1.6%. Thresholds not exceeded.
helen: CPU spike accounted for by cold-starts. Keep `kv_prefill=true` flag for cohort. If errors cross 0.4% at any point, we abort.
(40m) deploy-bot: progression to 15% queued in 2m.
gabby: New eval run shows accuracy delta -1.6% on the A deck for seeded prompts. That's above our desired 1% limit. Recommending hold and triage.
erin: Hold. Do not progress. @deploy-bot cancel the 15% progression.
deploy-bot: Progression canceled. Canary held at 5%. Will keep monitoring.
frank: We'll collect request traces for the failing prompts. Gabby, can you paste the failing prompt examples?
gabby: Pasting two snippets: "summarize user message X with context Y" and "rewrite to maintain tone Z" — both show hallucination on entity normalization.
erin: typo fixed: I suspect vocabulary tokenization differences in the 4.1.0 artifact; opening a quick compare between token tables.
deploy-bot: Manual rollback option queued. If humans issue `ffctl disable smart_batch_v4 --reason="quality regression"` I'll execute and pin traffic back to 4.0.7.
helen: Let's prefer a partial rollback: disable keyed cohorts for internal traffic and reduce cohort to 2% while we hotfix tokenization mismatch. That buys time for devs without full rollback. Thoughts?
erin: (fixing name) I like partial approach. Reduce to 2% and set `exclude_internal=true` on the flag.
gabby: That should remove noisy internal prompts from eval. Re-running eval with current cohort; please reduce to 2% now.
deploy-bot: Reducing cohort to 2%. Applying param `exclude_internal=true`.
deploy-bot: (2m) p95 now +9% errors 0.05% token-divergence +0.6% — holding.
frank: Autoscaler stabilized after pool resize. No further infra action.
erin: Devs: prioritize token table sync. If we can confirm mismatch, we'll cut v4.1.1 with aligned tokenizer and re-run the keyed cohort.
gabby: With current 2% the eval delta is -0.4% — acceptable. Recommend tagging the roll as "pause-and-fix" and schedule a follow-up rerun tomorrow in the morning window.
helen: I'll update release notes: add a note about "temporary limited rollout due to tokenizer mismatch; will reattempt after patch" and notify internal QA.
deploy-bot: Final status: cohort at 2%, flag `smart_batch_v4` live for keyed cohorts excluding internal traffic. Posting rollout summary to #release-logs and linking traces.
erin: Thanks everyone. I'll file a short retro and add a preflight check to block ramps past 5% if token-table checksum differs between artifact and catalog.
